components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Bone-filled pill CTA with a brand-blue hover ring; inverts on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--lp-text)); color: hsl(var(--lp-bg)); font-family: "Helvetica Now", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; text-decoration: none; outline: none; transition: transform 300ms, background-color 300ms, color 300ms; } .ds-btn-primary::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -2px; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lp-grad-from), var(--lp-grad-to)); opacity: 0; z-index: -1; transition: opacity 300ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { transform: scale(1.05); background: hsl(var(--lp-bg)); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); } .ds-btn-primary:hover::before, .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible::before { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Ink pill with a 2px hairline; brand-blue ring replaces the border on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-ghost { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 14px 28px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 2px solid hsl(var(--lp-stroke)); background: hsl(var(--lp-bg)); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: "Helvetica Now", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: transform 300ms, border-color 300ms; } .ds-btn-ghost::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -2px; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lp-grad-from), var(--lp-grad-to)); opacity: 0; z-index: -1; transition: opacity 300ms; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible { transform: scale(1.05); border-color: transparent; } .ds-btn-ghost:hover::before, .ds-btn-ghost:focus-visible::before { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Compact hairline pill for section actions such as Open a session.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 10px 20px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--lp-stroke)); border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--lp-bg)); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: "Helvetica Now", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: transform 300ms; } .ds-btn-outline::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -2px; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lp-grad-from), var(--lp-grad-to)); opacity: 0; z-index: -1; transition: opacity 300ms; } .ds-btn-outline:hover, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-btn-outline:hover::before, .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible::before { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Footer CTA
components.description: Charcoal pill used as the quieter Start free over the footer chart scrim.
components.css: .ds-btn-cta { position: relative; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 14px 32px; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--lp-surface)); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: "Helvetica Now", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: transform 300ms; } .ds-btn-cta::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: -2px; border-radius: 9999px; background-image: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--lp-grad-from), var(--lp-grad-to)); opacity: 0; z-index: -1; transition: opacity 300ms; } .ds-btn-cta:hover, .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-btn-cta:hover::before, .ds-btn-cta:focus-visible::before { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Floating Pill Nav
components.description: Top-center frosted pill with wing mark, Talaria-Log wordmark, sentence-case links, and Sign in.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; max-width: 100%; padding: 8px; border-radius: 9999px; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 0.1); background: hsl(var(--lp-surface)); backdrop-filter: blur(12px); } .ds-nav-brand { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 8px 0 6px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-mark { width: 32px; height: 32px; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-nav-wordmark { font-family: "Blauer Nue", "Exo 2", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-nav-rule { width: 1px; height: 20px; margin: 0 4px; background: hsl(var(--lp-stroke)); } .ds-nav-link { min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: transparent; color: hsl(var(--lp-muted)); font-family: "Helvetica Now", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-link:hover, .ds-nav-link:focus-visible { background: hsl(var(--lp-stroke) / 0.5); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); } .ds-nav-link-active { background: hsl(var(--lp-stroke) / 0.5); color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); } .ds-nav-signin { position: relative; min-height: 44px; padding: 0 16px; border: 0; border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--lp-surface)); color: hsl(var(--lp-muted)); font-family: "Helvetica Now", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; cursor: pointer; } .ds-nav-signin:hover, .ds-nav-signin:focus-visible { color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); }

components.name: Work Shot Card
components.description: 16px product-screenshot tile with semibold display title over an ink fade.
components.css: .ds-work { position: relative; display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 16 / 10; overflow: hidden; padding: 0; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--lp-stroke)); border-radius: 16px; background: hsl(var(--lp-surface)); cursor: pointer; text-align: left; } .ds-work-photo { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(160deg, #1a2838, #0a0c10); } .ds-work-fade { position: absolute; inset: auto 0 0 0; padding: 64px 20px 20px; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.85), transparent); } .ds-work-title { display: block; color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: "Blauer Nue", "Exo 2", "Helvetica Neue", sans-serif; font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.025em; } .ds-work-body { display: block; margin-top: 4px; max-width: 24rem; color: hsl(var(--lp-muted)); font-family: "Helvetica Now", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-work:hover, .ds-work:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lp-grad-from); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Journal Row
components.description: Pill row with circular instrument chip, note, PnL, and tracked meta.
components.html:
EURUSD

Break of London high, trail on 1m close

+42.612 Mar 2026
components.css: .ds-journal { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 24px; padding: 16px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--lp-stroke)); border-radius: 9999px; background: hsl(var(--lp-surface) / 0.3); transition: background-color 300ms; } .ds-journal:hover { background: hsl(var(--lp-surface)); } .ds-journal-chip { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 80px; height: 80px; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--lp-stroke)); border-radius: 9999px; color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: "Helvetica Now", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-journal-title { flex: 1; margin: 0; min-width: 12rem; color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: "Helvetica Now", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-journal-meta { display: flex; gap: 24px; padding: 0 16px; color: hsl(var(--lp-muted)); font-family: "Helvetica Now", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; }

components.name: Surface Tile
components.description: Rotated 16px product-surface frame with caption and a dark ambient drop.
components.css: .ds-surface { width: 200px; overflow: hidden; margin: 0; border: 1px solid hsl(var(--lp-stroke)); border-radius: 16px; background: hsl(var(--lp-surface)); box-shadow: 0 10px 15px -3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3), 0 4px 6px -4px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.3); transform: rotate(-5deg); } .ds-surface-photo { display: block; aspect-ratio: 4 / 3; background: linear-gradient(145deg, #1a2838, #0a0c10); } .ds-surface-caption { padding: 8px 12px; color: hsl(var(--lp-text)); font-family: "Helvetica Now", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.875rem; } .ds-surface:hover, .ds-surface:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--lp-grad-from); outline-offset: 4px; }

narrative.overview:
Talaria-Log’s marketing surface is a product-truth editorial shell, not a SaaS feature grid and not the Hero UI chart chrome. The visitor arrives through a near-black load of the official wing mark, then meets the 160px mark and Talaria-Log wordmark beside a framed EUR/USD 1-minute chart screenshot, with Start free and See how it works. Selected work, journal, and product surfaces are real screens — replay, journal, orders, news, indicators, strategy — then a muted chart reprise in the footer.

This file is the landing visual world. Product chrome stays on Hero UI tokens and components recorded in docs/DESIGN.md. The two systems share a type pairing with V9 chrome (Helvetica Now / Neue UI + Blauer Nue / Exo 2) and the brand-blue stops, but they do not share radius language, layout, or token format. The product name on this door is Talaria-Log. The official mark is /logo-07.png. Helvetica Now / Helvetica Neue / Helvetica / Arial (UI and body) and Blauer Nue / Exo 2 (display, self-hosted) are user-pinned for this marketing surface.
keyCharacteristics: Near-black HSL field (`--lp-*`) with bone type and fog secondary
Brand-blue gradient (`#3090ff` → `#232cf4`) as 2px hover rings only
Official three-bar wing mark plus Blauer Nue / Exo 2 wordmark
Framed product screenshots from `/landing/shot-*.png` (16px radius, hairline)
Floating top-center pill nav with Sign in
Pill chrome for controls; 16px rectangles for product frames
Semibold display for the name, section titles, accent verbs, and shot captions

rules.name: The Two Worlds Rule
rules.body: Landing color lives in `--lp-*` HSL channels scoped to `.landing-page`. App chrome keeps Hero UI OKLCH tokens in `docs/DESIGN.md`. Do not paint marketing with product `--background` / `--accent`, and do not paint the chart shell with `--lp-*`.

rules.name: The Brand Line Rule
rules.body: The brand-blue gradient is chrome, not fill. It may outline a pill on hover and focus. It may not fill a hero slab, a card, or a section background.

rules.name: The Pinned Pair Rule
rules.body: Helvetica Now / Helvetica Neue (UI, body) and Blauer Nue / Exo 2 (display) are user-pinned and match V9 chrome. Do not restore Inter, Instrument Serif, or a third marketing face.

rules.name: The Semibold Display Rule
rules.body: Display type is roman 600 with tight tracking. One accent word inside a Helvetica line may switch to Blauer Nue / Exo 2 semibold. Body paragraphs stay Helvetica roman. Do not italicize the name, titles, or verbs.

rules.name: The Atmosphere Rule
rules.body: Default depth is framed shots, scrim, and hairline — not offset card shadows. A drop shadow is a response (scrolled nav) or a shot-frame exception, never a rest state for journal rows.

rules.name: The Pill Chrome Rule
rules.body: Interactive chrome is `rounded-full`. Product photographs sit in 16px rounded rectangles. Do not square off buttons or nav, and do not invent a monogram disc in place of `/logo-07.png`.

rules.name: The Product Shot Rule
rules.body: Imagery is real Talaria-Log screens from `/landing/shot-*.png` (chart, journal, order, news, indicators, strategy). Do not restore HLS video, stock photography, or illustration as the hero or work tiles.

dos: Do scope landing styles to `.landing-page` / `.landing-overlay` and the `--lp-*` tokens.
Do set display type in Blauer Nue / Exo 2 semibold, and keep body, UI, and buttons in Helvetica Now / Helvetica Neue.
Do use the brand-blue gradient only as a 2px hover/focus ring.
Do lead with `/logo-07.png` and a framed `/landing/shot-*.png` product screenshot.
Do keep chrome `rounded-full`, product frames at 16px, and hit targets at least 44px.
Do cap reading copy around `max-w-md` / `max-w-xl` and the page column at 1200px.
Do respect `prefers-reduced-motion` on load, role cycle, hero reveal, and surface parallax.
donts: Don't mix this world with Hero UI components or OKLCH product tokens on the marketing page.
Don't fill a section, card, or hero with the brand-blue gradient.
Don't restore Inter, Instrument Serif, a TL monogram, or HLS video.
Don't set body paragraphs in the display face, or italicize display type.
Don't square off nav or buttons, or replace the official PNG with a letterform disc.
Don't load the full dataset or live chart engine into this door — screenshots are the product truth here.
Don't add a second chromatic accent. Bone, fog, and brand-blue are the voice.
